# Synthetic seed custody

Regenerate only with the genuine source producer and declared seed; do not edit
series values to satisfy a test. This snapshot was produced with the platform's
locked Python 3.14 environment. A replacement requires an explicit fixture
update, fresh SHA256SUMS, review and new complete acceptance on its source commit.

The copied runtime fixture remains part of the full source snapshot. It is never
an exception to source identity, a scientific result, or a model substitute.
See [README.md](README.md) for purpose.
